call_points.text: FY27 sales guided at ₹3,300-3,400 Cr and PAT at about ₹750 Cr, unchanged.
CFO told analysts not to annualise the Q1 Adcock bump; normal profit is about ₹100 Cr a quarter.
Organic capex runs at ₹250-300 Cr a year.
Carfilzomib launch is on track; the plant upgrade should finish by end of the year.
Two US launches are planned in the next financial year, with exclusivity.
Crop Health demerger may slip to about March from December because of the fundraise.
Semaglutide in India is cutthroat; the brand does about ₹2 Cr a month and barely makes money.
Olaparib trial date and exclusivity determination are both still open; management could not give the date.
From FY28, earnings expected to compound 15-25% a year, with FY27 as the base year.
South African associate Adcock Ingram guided at USD 580-600 million revenue and USD 47-48 million PAT.
FY27 tax rate guided at about 25% including surcharge under the new tax regime.
R&D spend guided at 7-9% of sales for FY27, already budgeted in the PAT guidance.
Brazil subsidiary revenue was about ₹257 Cr plus about ₹30 Cr billed from India, expected to reach USD 55-60 million this year.
Three of four US FDA facilities were inspected and cleared in 2025; Vizag API plant inspection expected any time this year.
Net cash of about ₹2,400 Cr at group level, earmarked for acquisitions rather than a buyback.
Crop health sciences revenue was about ₹140 Cr in FY26 versus ₹60 Cr last year; demerger in process.
Input raw material costs for crop health are up 25-30%; impact expected later in the year, not in the June or August quarter.
Management declined to name the exclusivities expected in FY28 and beyond, citing confidentiality.

operating_notes.text: Promoter and promoter-group shares in Natco Pharma were not pledged or encumbered at any point during FY ended 31 March 2026, per the Regulation 31(4) disclosure.
Received NPPA demand notice of ₹4.92 Cr for alleged overcharging across two drugs between April and November 2023.
US FDA approved Natco's ANDA for Eribulin Mesylate Injection (RLD Eisai's Halaven), filed with alliance partner Lupin; IQVIA MAT April 2026 US sales of the RLD were USD 43.7 million.
Semaglutide vial sells for less than ₹1,000 versus ₹3,000-4,000 for the pen; Natco was the only generic vial at launch and launched the pen about a month later.
Crop health sciences revenue was about ₹140 Cr in FY26 versus ₹60 Cr last year, with input raw material costs up 25-30%.
Brazil subsidiary revenue was about ₹257 Cr plus about ₹30 Cr billed from India; Canada revenue was ₹229 Cr in FY26.
Adcock Ingram's Q1FY27 revenue was ₹1,582.8 Cr and PAT ₹242.2 Cr; Natco's 35.75% share was ₹84.3 Cr, against a normal ₹35-40 Cr a quarter, on a strong South African flu season.
Semaglutide brand sales are about ₹2 Cr a month in India, and the domestic base business rose to about ₹130 Cr from a normal ₹107 Cr a quarter.
Crop Health Sciences has about 35 products, of which 8 are CTPR-related contributing 30-35% of revenue; FY26 revenue was about ₹138 Cr.
Carboplatin Injection (generic Paraplatin) launched in the US on 19 October 2026 by NATCO Pharma USA LLC with Teyro Labs; US market was USD 27.8 million for the 12 months to June 2026.

timeline.summary: On 29 April 2026 Natco disclosed promoter V.C. Nannapaneni's confirmation that promoter and promoter-group shares were not pledged or encumbered during FY ended 31 March 2026.
Natco Pharma received a ₹4.92 Cr demand notice from the NPPA for alleged overcharging on two drugs.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹739.1 Cr (-39.5% YoY), net profit ₹269 Cr.
On 3 June 2026 Natco and alliance partner Lupin received US FDA approval for Natco's ANDA for Eribulin Mesylate Injection, 1 mg/2ml, against a US market of USD 43.7 million (IQVIA MAT April 2026).
On 29 May 2026 Natco's Q4FY26 earnings call guided FY27 revenue at ₹3,400-3,500 Cr and PAT at ₹700-750 Cr, about half FY26, with 15-25% annual earnings growth expected from FY28.

On its 14 August 2026 Q1FY27 call, Natco kept FY27 guidance at ₹3,300-3,400 Cr sales and about ₹750 Cr PAT, said net cash was about ₹1,400 Cr after roughly ₹3,000 Cr of Adcock Ingram investments, and flagged a ₹2,000 Cr fundraise for acquisitions.

On 19 October 2026 Natco launched Carboplatin Injection, a generic of Paraplatin, in the US through NATCO Pharma USA LLC with Teyro Labs, into a US market it sizes at USD 27.8 million for the 12 months to June 2026.
Natco Pharma closed its ₹1,279.4 Cr rights issue on October 22, 2026, priced at ₹750 per share.
